title: Excel Data Cleaning & Reporting
boundary: Clean an Excel dataset and produce useful reporting with advanced formulas, pivot-style summaries, charts/graphs, filters, clear headings, consistent widths, and conditional formatting.
acceptance: Deliver a well-organized .xlsx file whose data is cleaned consistently and whose summaries/visuals make the resulting information easy to inspect.
result: PROTOTYPE PASS — synthetic workbook cleaned 23 raw rows to 20 unique normalized rows, removed 3 duplicates, flagged blank/invalid records, demonstrated the requested lookup/IF/SUMIF/COUNTIF/AVERAGEIF families, and produced zero formula-error matches.
next_movement: When the client source workbook arrives, agree the duplicate/error rules first, then apply the demonstrated cleaning/reporting pipeline and verify every correction against the source.
blockers: Final schema, source data, and the client definition of duplicates/obvious errors are not publicly supplied.
resume_bullets: Built an end-to-end Excel cleaning/reporting prototype with duplicate control, data-quality flags, VLOOKUP enrichment, IF/SUMIF/COUNTIF/AVERAGEIF summaries, filters, conditional formatting, and charts.
Reduced 23 messy demo rows to 20 unique normalized rows and validated the final workbook with zero formula-error matches.
notes: Public listing remained open when rechecked on 2026-10-03.
XLOOKUP equivalent is documented while VLOOKUP is active in the compatibility-focused demo.
